selections.text: [**abducens nucleus:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} A brainstem group containing the motor neurons recorded in the eye-drift study; their axons activate the lateral rectus eye muscle.

selections.text: [**activity bump:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} A localized peak of population firing rates across neurons ordered by their preferred represented values.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**attractor manifold:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} The continuous family of persistent activity states, described by its represented coordinates rather than by every neural activity separately.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**Betti numbers:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} Counts of independent connected components, loops, cavities, and their higher-dimensional counterparts.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**Brownian motion:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} A continuous random process starting at zero with independent Gaussian increments of mean zero and variance equal to elapsed time.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**causal filter:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} A rule whose current output depends only on present and past input.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**coefficient of determination:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} For the optimal linear prediction with an intercept, the fraction of response variance removed by prediction; with one predictor it equals the squared correlation.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**coefficient of variation:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} Standard deviation divided by mean; in the spike-train discussion it is applied to interspike intervals.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**continuous attractor:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} A continuous family of fixed points with restoring dynamics toward the family and neutral motion along it in the ideal deterministic model.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**convolution:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} An integral or sum combining past input values with a shifted response kernel to obtain a filtered output.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**correlation coefficient:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} Covariance divided by the product of standard deviations; a dimensionless measure of linear association.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**covariance:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} The mean product of two centered random variables, measuring their shared variation.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**Cramér Rao bound:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} A lower bound on local unbiased estimation variance under the required regularity conditions, expressed through inverse Fisher information.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**critical point:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} A point where a function's gradient is zero. The Euler calculation also requires invertible Hessians.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**decoding:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} Estimating a represented value from neural responses.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**dendrite:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} A branching input structure of a neuron.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**diffusion coefficient:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} The coefficient $D$ in the local one-dimensional displacement variance $2Dt$; its units are coordinate squared per time.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**diffusion tensor:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} The matrix giving local coordinate-displacement covariances per twice the elapsed time.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**Dirac delta:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} A point-mass distribution; in the initial-condition equation all probability is concentrated at the specified coordinate.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**encoding:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} Establishing a population activity pattern from an input.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**Euler characteristic:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} The alternating sum of Betti numbers; in three dimensions, components minus independent loops plus enclosed cavities.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**excess kurtosis:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} The fourth centered moment divided by the squared variance, minus three. It is zero for a Gaussian population.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**excitatory input:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} In the models used here, an input that increases a receiving neuron's tendency to fire.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**excursion set:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} The positions where a function exceeds a specified level.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**Fano factor:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} Spike-count variance divided by mean count, for a specified counting interval and condition.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**firing rate:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} The expected number of spikes per unit time, conditional on the modeled circumstances.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**Fisher information:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} The expected squared score, quantifying the local sensitivity of a probability distribution to a parameter.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**fixational drift:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} Slow eye motion during attempted fixation, between rapid eye movements.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**fixed point:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} A state whose deterministic rate of change is zero.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**Fokker Planck equation:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} An equation describing how a probability density evolves under drift and diffusion; the guide states the convention before using it.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**gain:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} The scale that converts a change in one signal into a change in another.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**gamma function:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} The function $\Gamma(t)=\int_0^\infty u^{t-1}e^{-u}\,du$ for $t>0$, extending factorials through $\Gamma(n+1)=n!$.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**Gaussian curvature:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} For a surface in three dimensions, the product of its two principal curvatures.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**Gaussian process:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} A distribution over functions whose values at any finite collection of positions have a joint Gaussian distribution.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**grid cell:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} A spatially tuned entorhinal neuron with repeated firing fields, often approximately hexagonally arranged in a two-dimensional arena.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**Hessian:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} The matrix of second derivatives of a function with respect to its coordinates.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**hippocampus:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} A brain region involved in memory and navigation.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**hyperbolic cotangent:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} The function $\coth z=1/\tanh z$, for real $z\ne0$.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**hyperbolic tangent:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} The function $\tanh z=(e^z-e^{-z})/(e^z+e^{-z})$.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**impulse response:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} The output of a linear filter in response to a unit-area input impulse, from which responses to general input can be assembled.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**inhibitory input:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} In the models used here, an input that reduces a receiving neuron's tendency to fire.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**internal Fisher information rate:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} The local information per unit observation time about the instantaneous attractor coordinate, as defined by the 2012 spike model.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**inverse hyperbolic tangent:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} The inverse of $\tanh$ on $(-1,1)$, given by $\operatorname{artanh}z=\tfrac12\log[(1+z)/(1-z)]$.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**Isotropy:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} Invariance of the spatial probability law under rotations.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**Itô convention:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} A stochastic-increment convention that evaluates the noise coefficient at the beginning of each increment.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**jointly Gaussian vector:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} A random vector for which every linear combination of its entries is Gaussian.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**Kac–Rice formula:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} A way to compute expected crossing or critical-point counts from the joint distribution of a random function and its derivatives, under the relevant regularity assumptions.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**left zero eigenvector:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} A vector $v$ with $v^T A=0$; with appropriate normalization it extracts the persistent coordinate from a small state disturbance.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**likelihood:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} The probability or density of the observed data considered as a function of a proposed parameter value.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**linearization:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} The first-order approximation to a dynamical equation near a reference state.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**lognormal distribution:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} A distribution of positive values whose logarithms are Gaussian.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**low pass filter:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} A filter that suppresses sufficiently rapid input changes relative to slower ones.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**mean curvature:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} For a surface in three dimensions, the average of its two principal curvatures.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**mean squared displacement:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} The average squared change in a coordinate across a specified time lag.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**microsaccades:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} Brief, rapid eye movements that occur during attempted fixation.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**Morse theory:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} A theory relating the topology of a function's level-set regions to its critical points. The guide uses a signed critical-point count under its smoothness and nondegeneracy assumptions, including boundary contributions.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**neural transfer function:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} The modeled relationship between a neuron's input and its expected firing rate.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**neuron:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} A signaling cell in the nervous system.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**ocular motoneurons (OMNs):**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} Neurons whose spikes activate the eye muscles.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**ocular plant:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} The muscles and mechanical eye system that transform motor activity into eye motion.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**oculomotor integrator:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} A neural circuit that converts movement commands into a maintained eye-position command.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**p value:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} Under the specified null comparison, the probability of a test statistic at least as extreme in the tested direction as the observed one.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**path integration:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} Updating an estimate of position from movement.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**place cell:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} A spatially selective hippocampal neuron that fires strongly in one or more localized regions of an environment.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**place field:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} A connected region of elevated spatial firing, as defined by the model or stated measurement procedure.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**Poisson process:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} A counting process with independent increments and a deterministic constant or time-dependent event rate; its count over an interval has equal mean and variance. In a recurrent model, conditionally Poisson instantaneous spike generation does not make complete spike trains have independent increments.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**population code:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} A representation carried by the pattern of responses across neurons.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**precision:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} The reciprocal of variance for a scalar Gaussian estimate.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**preferred angle:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} An angle where a neuron's tuning curve peaks.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**prior distribution:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} A distribution representing knowledge about likely parameter values before observing the current data.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**rate map:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} An estimate of spatial firing rate from spikes per time spent at each position.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**Rayleigh distribution:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} The distribution of a positive variable that is a scaled square root of an exponential variable.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**recurrent connectivity:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} Connections that feed activity back into the same neuronal population.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**renewal process:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} An event process with independent, identically distributed intervals under the fixed conditions being modeled.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**retina:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} The light-sensitive tissue at the back of the eye.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**right zero eigenvector:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} A state-space direction $u$ satisfying $Au=0$ for the linearized dynamics.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**root mean squared displacement:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} The square root of mean squared displacement, expressed in the original coordinate's units.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**score:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} The derivative of log likelihood with respect to the parameter being estimated.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**skew:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} The third centered moment divided by the variance to the power $3/2$, measuring asymmetry.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**Smoothness:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} The existence and regularity of derivatives of a function. The crossing and peak calculations require different derivative orders.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**spike:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} A brief electrical event emitted by a neuron.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**standard error of the mean (SEM):**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} An estimate of uncertainty in a sample mean. Its interpretation depends on which observations are treated as independent, such as trials, cells, or animals.

selections.text: [**state:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} The quantities that specify a modeled system's current condition and determine its subsequent dynamics together with future inputs and noise.

selections.text: [**Stationarity:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} In the place-field model, invariance of spatial statistics under translating the map.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**stationary process:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} A random process whose probability law is unchanged by shifting its time or position origin; weaker covariance-only stationarity must be specified when used.

selections.text: [**Stratonovich convention:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} A stochastic-increment convention using midpoint evaluation in the limiting increments.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**sub-Poisson spiking:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} Spiking with less variability than a matched Poisson reference according to the stated measure and conditions.

selections.text: [**superdiffusion:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} Mean squared displacement growing faster than linearly with lag over the range being described.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**synapse:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} A connection through which one neuron influences another.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**systematic drift:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} A nonzero mean velocity of the represented coordinate, distinct from random spreading.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**Translation invariance:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} In the readout model, invariance under shifts of the represented value. It makes the readout variance independent of the cue state.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**tuning curve:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} A neuron's expected firing rate as a function of a represented variable.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**unbiased:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} Describes an estimator whose expected value equals the parameter locally under the conditions used in the estimation bound.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**upcrossing:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} A point where a function crosses upward through a specified threshold.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**weak fluctuation approximation:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} An expansion about the deterministic population dynamics in which the aggregate effects of many small spike contributions remain small.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**Weibull distribution:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} A positive-variable distribution with survival probability $\exp[-(s/b)^k]$, scale $b>0$, and shape $k>0$.
selections.reason: The existing glossary entry is a definition unit.

selections.text: [**White noise:**]{.definition-term custom-style="Definition Term"} An ideal noise input with zero covariance at unequal times and a delta-function covariance at equal times; its integrated increments have finite variance.
